svg.title: AIcoach — Other pages (Frame + Conversation)
svg.text: Same two columns everywhere: the stage on the left shows the one picture that matters, the right side says one thing. On the phone the stage becomes the slim top frame.

g.text: Sign in to see your swings.
Your swings are private to you.
Six steps · about a minute to read
One swing per clip, good light
I won’t guess from this clip. Three things got in the way:
I only read down the line, from behind.
Hips and posture need the whole body.
No result was made. Nothing was saved.

text.tspan: None of my three rules fired on your swing,
so I won’t prescribe a drill.
Weight appears to move toward the trail

g.text: 5 saved swings · only you can see them
Swings you don’t save are deleted after analysis.

text.tspan: This removes 9 analyses with their results
and key frames, and 5 saved swing clips.
